body:
## Council question

What are all exceptions to retaining cards through Fanatical Tactics?

## Why this needs a ruling

Quickstart v0.8 mentions the traitor exception. The live Fremen text also addresses lasgun-shield explosions and same-color Spite replacement. Supplies introduces temporary cards with an end-of-phase expiry.

## Answer needed

Confirm the complete exception list and whether revealed Supplies-cache cards can ever survive their normal expiry.

## Provisional drafting approach

Start from the complete live Fremen text and keep temporary Supplies expiry explicit.

This is a research question, not an adopted ruling or a claim that Norbert has answered it. No answer has been supplied yet. Keep the affected rules provisional until Norbert or the council confirms them.

## Sources

[Live Fremen](https://dune.zone/factions/fremen); Quickstart v0.8, Fanatical Tactics and Supplies.

Part of #1831. Record the confirmed answer, its date and a worked example here before closing. Norbert will share this link with the council; this ticket does not send them a message.
title: Dreamrules ruling: What are all exceptions to retaining cards through Fanatical Tactics?
